recommendations.title: Buy New York Knicks -2.5
recommendations.matchup: San Antonio Spurs at New York Knicks
recommendations.reason: Recommendation: buy New York Knicks -2.5 at home. The no-vig spread market gives them about a 48% chance to cover, and after our home-court and bucket adjustments we land near 51%. Priced at -102, that works out to roughly +0.5% expected value per dollar, so the side clears our minimum-edge filter.
